description: Event catalogue for the Personal Loan Application and Drawdown journey. Introduces 4 events: EVT-152 through EVT-155. EVT-153 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) is published by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) — the only cross-capability event produced by a non-CAP-001 service in this journey.

events.name: LoanApplicationSubmitted
events.trigger: Customer completes and submits loan application with income and expenditure data.

derived_from.gross_monthly_income: LoanApplication.gross_monthly_income — self-declared; credit assessment may verify

consumers.action: Trigger credit bureau check, DTI calculation, affordability stress test. Publish CreditAssessmentCompleted.
AML monitoring for loan origination — check for structuring risk.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.lending.
events.worm_rationale: Loan application with income/expenditure data is a consumer credit record — immutable for FCA/CCA audit.

events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — assessment result, no persisted entity in SVC-012
events.trigger: SVC-012 completes credit bureau check, DTI calculation, and affordability stress test for the loan application.

payload_schema.risk_band: string enum (A | B | C | D | E | declined)
payload_schema.recommended_apr: string (decimal as string) — nullable if declined
payload_schema.monthly_repayment: string (decimal as string) — nullable if declined
payload_schema.bureau_search_reference: string — credit bureau search reference for audit

derived_from.recommended_apr: risk_band → APR mapping table in SVC-012 pricing model
derived_from.monthly_repayment: computed_from: amortisation formula using recommended_apr, loan_amount, term_months

consumers.action: Update LoanApplication with assessment result. Present offer to customer if approved. Route to manual review if referred. Record decline if declined.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering. CreditAssessmentCompleted must follow LoanApplicationSubmitted for same application_id.
events.worm_rationale: Credit assessment result is a consumer credit decision — ICO Article 22 audit trail required.

events.name: LoanAgreementExecuted
events.trigger: Customer accepts loan offer, completes SCA, and LoanAgreement is created with status = executed.

derived_from.apr: LoanAgreement.apr — final contracted rate from credit assessment
derived_from.first_repayment_date: computed_from: agreement_date + 30-31 days (next full calendar month)

consumers.action: Record consumer credit agreement for CONC regulatory reporting.
Initiate loan drawdown payment to nominated account.
Write immutable agreement execution audit record (6-year retention).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering. LoanAgreementExecuted follows CreditAssessmentCompleted for same application_id.
events.worm_rationale: Consumer credit agreement execution is legally binding — immutable audit trail required for 6 years.

events.name: LoanDrawdownCompleted
events.trigger: Loan proceeds successfully disbursed to customer's nominated account. LoanAccount status = active.

derived_from.drawdown_amount: LoanAccount.drawdown_amount — equals loan_amount in standard case

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account ordering. LoanDrawdownCompleted follows LoanAgreementExecuted for same agreement_id.
